bullets.text: AirDrop Codes Enhance Security - **Apple** introduces a verification layer for AirDrop with iOS 26.2, improving user safety.
Shazam's Popular Segments Feature - **Shazam** now highlights song moments that capture user attention, enhancing music discovery.
Apple Glasses Rumors Surface - Anticipation builds for **Apple's** smart glasses, expected to feature AI-driven capabilities.
iOS 26.2 Improves Liquid Glass - Users can now adjust the transparency of the Lock Screen with **Apple's** latest update.
Emergency Security Updates Released - **Google** and **Apple** respond to zero-day attacks with urgent software patches.
Data Breach Affects Millions - A breach at **700Credit** compromises personal data of at least 5.6 million individuals.
Microsoft's Carbon Removal Initiative - **Microsoft** commits to purchasing 3.6 million carbon removal credits from a new bioenergy plant.
Real-Time Translations in Headphones - **Google Translate** introduces live translation capabilities for headphones, enhancing communication.
